text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... ...My time didn't 
improve, huh...
Tarumae-chaaann! Hey, hey, let's go hang—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Were you in the middle of solo 
training?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! I've been struggling with my 
running form, so I'm getting in some 
distance runs.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? But I think Tarumae-chan is more 
like a contrail zooming through the sky."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good luck with your solo 
training! Let's hang out again next time~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Zooom...? A vapor trail...?? ...What could 
that mean?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Mayano-chan, there's gotta be some 
meaning to it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know! If I record my own running form, 
maybe I can see how it looks from 
Mayano-chan's perspective!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is clockwise, and this is 
counterclockwise... ...Ah, leaning a 
little bit on the turns.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... That swooshing motion might be 
about course selection habits... If so—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Amazing! Your time got better!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ta-ru-ma-e-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Mayano-chan...! You know, to tell the 
truth, your post—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your running just now was totally 
sparkling! And so, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Run with Maya!! Just watching got Maya all 
restless and itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh...! With my... running...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
~~~... Yes! Definitely! I'm gonna zoom 
right past everyone!

From this day on, Hokko Tarumae's running 
became more refined and gained even more 
sharpness.
